limits: Six actual AllocMem owners plus four required fixed AllocAbs ranges, not unrestricted dynamic loading.

Standalone manifest checks establish integrity, not authentication. Shared verify-package additionally rebinds to the current canonical export.
Assembly/build verification does not prove wrapper correctness, all-path execution, universal hardware support or graphics/audio equivalence.
Original byte-exact export and unresolved eight-CCK discrepancy remain separate.
Proprietary payload, ROM, source-selected asset bytes and raw captures remain private; published code/receipts reproduce the package from local target input.
